PluginData.Tooltip: Hull making allowing for clicking and dragging following geometry.
PluginData.Description: ArmorFlow analyzes existing armor geometry and helps you find, preview and build matching armor shapes. Has an optional Rich HUD Master gui that labels the price of what you are placing, You can use N ( Default Keybind ) to attempt to match the geometry of the block you are looking at or... You can use Shift + N to switch to hull mode placing multiple points to place a large amount of blocks while attempting to match geometry and slope
